label: Bible Study
prompt: My God, my God, why hast thou _____ me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
verse: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
note: The cry Jesus prayed from the cross — a psalm that ends, remarkably, in praise.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jesus, moved with _____, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
verse: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
note: A leper said 'if thou wilt' — Jesus, moved with compassion, touched the untouchable and said 'I will.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And many spread their _____ in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verse: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
note: The crowd paved the road with their own garments and cut branches — a red carpet, Jerusalem style.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye _____ not, even as others which have no hope.
verse: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
note: Paul doesn't forbid grief — just hopeless grief; believers who've died are only 'asleep.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that _____ in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
verse: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
note: Scripture as a lamp that 'shineth in a dark place' until the day dawns and the day star rises in your heart.
